sn52.1:1.1: evaṃ gaṅgāpeyyālo yāva esanā pāli iddhipādesu vitthāretabbā). iddhipādasaṃyuttaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. anuruddhasaṃyuttaṃ rahogatavaggo paṭhamo evamme sutaṃ
sn52.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā anuruddho sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn52.1:1.3: atha kho āyasmato anuruddhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
sn52.1:1.4: yesaṃ kesañci cattāro satipaṭṭhānā viraddhā viraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī
sn52.1:1.5: yesaṃ kesañci cattāro satipaṭṭhānā āraddhā āraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmīti.
sn52.1:2.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno āyasmato anuruddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva āyasmato anuruddhassa sammukhe pāturahosi.
sn52.1:2.2: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca
sn52.1:2.3: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso anuruddha bhikkhuno cattāro satipaṭṭhānā āraddhā hontīti.
sn52.1:3.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ kāye samudayadhammānupassī viharati …pe… ajjhattaṃ kāye vayadhammānupassī viharati. ajjhattaṃ kāye samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.1:3.2: bahiddhā kāye samudayadhammānupassī viharati …pe… bahiddhā kāye vayadhammānupassī viharati. bahiddhā kāye samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.1:3.3: ajjhattabahiddhā kāye samudayadhammānupassī viharati. ajjhattabahiddhā kāye vayadhammānupassī viharati. ajjhattabahiddhā kāye samudayavayadhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.1:4.1: so sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikūle paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati.
sn52.1:4.2: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikūle appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti appaṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati.
sn52.1:4.3: sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikūle ca paṭikūle ca paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti paṭikūlasaññī tatatha viharati.
